correctness.rationale: For every N>=3 and complex nonzero gamma, splitting the finite ambiguity sum gives the displayed rational expression and the separate r=1,b=0 value. Magnitudes force k=N/2 on the nonunit branch; a unimodular Möbius factor makes the two exceptional phases exactly gamma^N real. On the unit branch, character orthogonality forces N|bk and gcd counting supplies the exact rank. Weyl-basis diagonalization proves rank=#nonzero coefficients, and the N/2 disjoint Hermitian rank-two kernel matrices give explicit ambiguous signals at even nonunit resonances. For unit ratios delta_0 and delta_1 are indistinguishable; for every nonunit ratio shift 0 and shift 1 ambiguity rows are zero-free, proving recovery of nowhere-zero vectors. Independent direct-sum computation completed 7070 comparisons for N=3..14 and 12 explicit ambiguous pairs; it is supplementary to the general proof.
